{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Steel}}
{{Quote|Your father's lightsaber&mdash;encased in transparisteel and given a place of honor to mark a fallen, but esteemed foe.|Darth Krayt, to Cade Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy15">[[Legacy (2006) 15|''Legacy'' (2006) 15]]</ref>}}
[[File:KolSkywalkerLightsaber-Legacy2006-15.jpg|thumb|250px|Kol Skywalker's lightsaber in a transparisteel display case]]
'''Transparisteel''' or '''transparasteel''' was a hard and completely transparent metal alloy. This made it a commonly used material for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Viewport/Legends|viewports]] and the windows of strongholds and other buildings where security was a must. Transparisteel could be made phototropic, to become more opaque near bright explosions or while traveling through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. A major component in the make-up of transparisteel was [[Lommite/Legends|lommite]].{{Fact}} A malleable metal, transparisteel was press-formed into thin, transparent sheets that retained its characteristic strength.<ref name="AGSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>

Transparisteel was much weaker than its opaque counterpart [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]. It offered a less clear view than [[clari-crystalline]] or [[Glass/Legends|glass]], but was more resilient,{{Fact}} and was often used in place of glass for many deep-space structures.<ref name="AGSWU" />

[[Darth Krayt]] encased the [[Kol Skywalker's lightsaber|lightsaber]] of [[Cade Skywalker|Cade's]] father, [[Kol Skywalker]], in transparisteel case to honor him.<ref name="Legacy15" />

Transparisteel was used in the windows of [[Skimmersub]]s.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

The High Council Chambers of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant had floor-to-ceiling windows made of transparisteel to withstand the winds at the altitude.<ref name="Star Wars Jedi Apprentice: The Captive Temple">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Captive Temple]]''</ref>

[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] had a [[Padmé Amidala's amulet|transparisteel amulet]] made by her parents when she became the Queen of Naboo.<ref name="The Queen's Amulet">''[[The Queen's Amulet]]''</ref><ref name="Star Wars Episode I Journal: Queen Amidala">''[[Star Wars Journal: Queen Amidala]]''</ref>
